2607.22300.title: Biomedical Machine Translation for Low-Resource Arabic-Script Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and LoRA Adapter Merging
2607.22300.paper_summary: We present a systematic study of healthcare-domain cross-lingual transfer to address the scarcity of biomedical NMT resources for Arabic-script languages. We use Arabic and Persian as higher-resource pivots to improve translation for \textbf{four severely low-resource} targets: Dari (Afghan Persian, a standardised variety of Persian), Pashto, Sorani Kurdish (Central Kurdish, a major standardized variety of Kurdish), and Urdu (closely related to Hindi). Using LoRA fine-tuning on small decoder-only LLMs, we train \textit{domain-specific pivot adapters} and evaluate \textbf{three transfer strategies}: few-shot in-context learning, minimal supervised adaptation, and, to the best of our knowledge, for the first time in this setting, zero-data LoRA adapter merging. Supervised adaptation with just 500 sentences achieves near pivot-language quality for Dari (CHrF++ 41.01) and meaningful gains for Urdu (28.88), while adapter merging reaches within 3.5 CHrF++ of supervised adaptation for Dari at zero additional cost. Pashto and Sorani Kurdish remain insufficient for high-stakes clinical deployment exposing the limits of cross-lingual transfer when structural distance from the pivots is too great. LoRA adapter merging works surprisingly well for closely related languages, even without target-language biomedical data.
2607.22300.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一項系統性的醫療領域跨語言轉移研究，以解決阿拉伯字母語言的生物醫學NMT資源稀缺問題。 我們使用阿拉伯語和波斯語作為高資源樞紐，以改善對\textbf{四種極度低資源}目標的翻譯：達里語（阿富汗波斯語，一種標準化的波斯語變體）、普什圖語、索拉尼庫爾德語（中央庫爾德語，一種主要的標準化庫爾德語變體）和烏爾都語（與印地語密切相關）。 通過在小型解碼器專用LLM上使用LoRA微調，我們訓練\textit{特定領域的樞紐適配器}並評估\textbf{三種轉移策略}：少量上下文學習、最小監督適應，以及在我們的知識範圍內，首次在這種情境下進行零數據LoRA適配器合併。 僅使用500個句子的監督適應對於達里語實現了接近樞紐語言的質量（CHrF++ 41.01），並對於烏爾都語實現了有意義的增益（28.88），而適配器合併在零額外成本下達里語的CHrF++達到了監督適應的3.5以內。 普什圖語和索拉尼庫爾德語對於高風險臨床部署仍然不足，暴露了當結構距離樞紐過大時跨語言轉移的限制。 LoRA適配器合併對於密切相關的語言效果驚人，即使沒有目標語言的生物醫學數據。
